{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows low positivity (≤0.33) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent true outcomes show strong mean reversion or downward correction after spikes.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices (e.g., <65) when sentiment is neutral or negative, to avoid underestimating rebound potential.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast 3-5 days prior, adjust current forecast downward by 3-7%.",
    "Avoid over-optimism after high sentiment spikes: if sentiment >0.67 and price spikes >10% above recent mean, cap forecast increase at +5% to prevent overshoot.",
    "When sentiment history shows consistent 0.00, apply a conservative bias correction: forecast = true outcome - 2% to 5% to account for model drift.",
    "For 30-day horizon, if true outcome deviates >10% from 15-day moving average, adjust forecast to align with recent trend, not historical mean."
  ]
}
